about: 부스에서 쓸 질문 묶음이다. 한국어를 고르면 영어가 보인다. 미리 번역해 두어서 인터넷 없이도 된다. 영어는 Orca가 적은 초안이니 사람이 다듬는다 (이 파일만 고치면 된다). 묶음의 차례가 화면의 차례다.

notice.ko: 제 메모를 위해 이 대화를 녹음해도 될까요?
notice.en: May I record this conversation for my own notes?

items.en: Hello. I'm a student from Korea.

items.ko: 이 제품을 잠깐 설명해 주실 수 있나요?
items.en: Could you briefly explain this product?
Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
Thank you for explaining.

items.ko: 이 제품은 어떤 문제를 풀어 주나요?
items.en: What problem does this product solve?
How is it different from other products?
May I try it myself?
What technology does it use?
Who mainly uses it?
How much does it cost?
Can students or individuals buy it?
Is there a separate subscription fee?
When will it be released?
Is it available to buy now?
What will change in the next version?
Is it available in Korea?
Does it support Korean?
Do you have a partner in Korea?
Do you hire interns or new graduates?
What skills are you looking for?
Can international students apply?
Where can I apply?
May I have your business card?
My contact details are in this QR code.
May I email you with questions later?
How can I join the event?
Should I put my business card in here?

items.ko: 종이 명함이 없는데 다른 방법이 있나요?
items.en: I don't have a paper card. Is there another way to enter?
When and how will the results be announced?
